parameters.help_en: The domain name ID. You can call the QueryDomainByParam operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: domain_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether real-time DNS resolution is required
parameters.name: require_real_time_dns_records

CnameAuthStatus.description_en:
The CNAME verification status. Valid values:
0: Successful.
1: Failed

CnameConfirmStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the host record of the CNAME record is modified. Valid values:
1: Modified. Changing the value back to the original value is also considered a modification.
0: Not modified
CnameConfirmStatus.description_zh: 是否改动了CNAME的主机记录，已改动：1（改回原来值也算改动），未改动：0

CnameRecord.description_en: The custom part of the CNAME host record

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the domain name was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in UTC, accurate to the minute
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 时间格式，精确到分钟

DefaultDomain.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name is the default domain name. [Deprecated] Valid values:
0: No
DefaultDomain.description_zh:
是否为默认域名，

值：0 否（该字段已弃用）

DkimAuthStatus.description_en:
The DKIM verification status, which indicates whether the DKIM record configured in DNS has passed the verification. Valid values:
0: Passed.
1: Failed
DkimAuthStatus.description_zh: DKIM 验证标志，用户在dns设置的dkim记录是否已经校验通过, 0:通过， 1:未通过

DkimPublicKey.description_en: The DKIM public key value, which is the value of the DKIM record that you need to configure in DNS
DkimPublicKey.description_zh: DKIM公钥值，用户需要在dns上设置的dkim记录的value

DkimRR.description_en: The DKIM host record, which is the key of the DKIM record that you need to configure in DNS
DkimRR.description_zh: DKIM主机记录，用户需要在dns上设置的dkim记录的key

DkimRsaLength.description_en: The length of the RSA key used for DKIM, such as 1024 or 2048
DkimRsaLength.description_zh: DKIM 使用的 RSA 密钥的长度，例如 1024、2048

DmarcAuthStatus.description_en:
The DMARC verification status, which indicates whether the DMARC record configured in DNS has passed the verification. Valid values:
0: Passed.
1: Failed
DmarcAuthStatus.description_zh: DMARC 验证标志，用户在dns设置的DMARC记录是否已经校验通过, 0:通过， 1:未通过

DnsDmarc.description_en: The DMARC record value resolved from the public domain name
DnsDmarc.description_zh: 通过公网域名解析到的DMARC记录值

DnsMx.description_en: The MX record value resolved from the public domain name
DnsMx.description_zh: 通过公网域名解析到的MX记录值

DnsSpf.description_en: The SPF record value resolved from the public domain name
DnsSpf.description_zh: 通过公网域名解析到的spf记录值

DnsTxt.description_en: The ownership record value resolved from the public domain name
DnsTxt.description_zh: 通过公网域名解析到的所有权记录值

DomainStatus.description_en:
The domain name status, which indicates whether the verification is successful. Valid values:

0: Available. The verification is successful.
1: Unavailable. The verification failed
DomainStatus.description_zh:
域名状态。说明是否验证成功，取值：

0：可用，已验证通过
1：不可用，验证未通过

DomainType.description_en: The ownership record provided by the DirectMail console
DomainType.description_zh: 邮件推送控制台提供的所有权记录

DomainVersion.description_en:
The domain name version. Valid values:
0: Old version.
1: New version. The configuration items required to pass the verification vary based on the version
DomainVersion.description_zh: 域名版本号，0为旧版本，1为新版本。校验通过需要的配置项不同
DomainVersion.title_en: 域名版本号，0为旧版本，1为新版本。校验通过需要的配置项不同
DomainVersion.title_zh: 域名版本号，0为旧版本，1为新版本。校验通过需要的配置项不同

IcpStatus.description_en:
The ICP filing status. Valid values:
1: Filed.
0: Not filed
IcpStatus.description_zh: 备案状态。1表示已备案，0表示未备案

MxAuthStatus.description_en:
The MX verification status. Valid values:
0: Successful.
1: Failed

MxRecord.description_en: The MX record value provided by the DirectMail console
MxRecord.description_zh: 邮件推送控制台提供的MX记录值

SpfAuthStatus.description_en:
The SPF verification status. Valid values:
0: Successful.
1: Failed

SpfRecord.description_en: The SPF record value provided by the DirectMail console
SpfRecord.description_zh: 邮件推送控制台提供的spf记录值

SpfRecordV2.description_en: The SPF record. Previously, the displayed SPF content had to be calculated by the client based on the spfRecord parameter in the response. The spfRecordV2 parameter is added to replace the spfRecord parameter, allowing the client to directly display its value
SpfRecordV2.description_zh: spf记录，以前spf展示内容需要调用端根据响应中的spfRecord计算得出，新增字段spfRecordV2取代spfRecord， 调用端拿到该字段后可以直接进行展示；

TracefRecord.description_en: The CNAME record value provided by the DirectMail console
TracefRecord.description_zh: 邮件推送控制台提供的CNAME记录值
